templates.prompt: Name a book of the Bible (the 66-book Protestant canon)
Name a book of the Old Testament (Protestant canon)
Name a book of the New Testament
Name a book of the Torah (the first five books of the Bible)
Name one of the Major Prophets (Isaiah through Daniel, including Lamentations)
Name one of the twelve Minor Prophets
Name one of the four Gospels
Name one of the 13 letters traditionally attributed to Paul
Name a historical book of the Old Testament (Joshua through Esther)
Name one of the eight General Epistles (Hebrews through Jude)

prompt.starts: Name a book of the Bible that starts with the letter {L} (ignore any number in front)
prompt.contains: Name a book of the Bible with the letter {L} in its name (ignore any number in front)
prompt.lacks: Name a book of the Bible with no letter {L} in its name (ignore any number in front)
